# Source: Murasaki Shikibu, from the series "Ukiyo-e Genji"

This GameCore theme is derived from a **specific, real, public-domain work**—not a generated palette.

## Work

- **Title:** Murasaki Shikibu, from the series "Ukiyo-e Genji"
- **Artist / culture:** Okumura Masanobu Japanese, 1686-1764
- **Date:** Edo period (1615–1868), about 1710
- **Style:** Japanese (culture or style)
- **Classification:** woodblock print
- **Department:** Arts of Asia
- **AIC artwork ID:** 19584
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/19584
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/607ff8ac-8d1b-170d-7b35-d4004017cb66/full/400,/0/default.jpg
- **Research category:** Ukiyo-e

## Extracted source palette

`#E8D8C8, #C8C8A8, #A8A888, #988878, #787868, #585848, #383828, #C8B888`

The image was downsampled deterministically and quantized to a four-bit-per-channel histogram.
Colors were ranked by pixel population and de-duplicated by RGB distance. No random values are used.

## Semantic adaptation

- `background`: `#F5EFE8`
- `surface`: `#FCF9F7`
- `on_surface`: `#0F0F11`
- `primary`: `#383828`
- `on_primary`: `#F8F8F6`
- `secondary`: `#C8B888`
- `surface_variant`: `#D9D4CE`
- `on_surface_variant`: `#0F0F11`
- `outline`: `#B5B0AC`
- `error`: `#383828`
- `on_error`: `#F8F8F6`

- Font: `serif` (chosen from source style/classification)
- Corner radius: `6dp` (chosen from source object/design classification)
- Body contrast: background `16.77:1`, surface `18.27:1`
- Variant contrast: `13.0:1`
- Control contrast: `11.19:1`

Backgrounds retain a source hue but are toned toward neutral only when needed to ensure body text is
at least 7.0:1. The primary action remains an extracted source color and its ink is chosen
for at least 4.5:1.
